name: ai-daily-cn-static-publisher
description: Local static publishing infrastructure for Chinese AI daily reports.

scripts.status:self-check: node src/cli.js status:self-check --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
scripts.build: node src/cli.js build --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
scripts.test: node --test tests/unit.test.js tests/publish.test.js tests/skills.test.js tests/story-authoring.test.js tests/generation-first.test.js tests/content-contract.test.js tests/page-check-tiering.test.js tests/source-coverage.test.js tests/trends.test.js
scripts.validate: npm run harness:init && npm run harness:validate && npm run retrospectives:validate && npm run content:contract && npm run content:contract:self-test && npm run feedback:validate && npm run workflow:validate && npm run resilience:validate && npm run sources:validate && npm run test && npm run build:check-clean && npm run privacy:validate && npm run test:e2e && git diff --check
scripts.publish:dry-run: node src/cli.js publish:dry-run --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
scripts.publish:dry-run:daily: node src/cli.js publish:dry-run:daily --data-input reports-data --input reports-source --out docs
